instruction:
Battery BMS service-cover enclosure. The desktop contains `/home/user/Desktop/board_input.kicad_pcb`, `/home/user/Desktop/mechanical_requirements.json`, `/home/user/Desktop/connector_keepouts.csv`, `/home/user/Desktop/enclosure_seed.scad`, and `/home/user/Desktop/handoff_notes.md`. The handoff notes are supplementary and cannot override the KiCad board, requirements JSON, or connector CSV. KiCad-derived JSON, CSV, and SCAD handoffs may be generated by a deterministic parser within the KiCad stage; kicad-cli and the parser handoffs must both complete before OpenSCAD consumes them, but no particular helper script name or ordering between those KiCad-stage operations is required. Run the CLI handoff in this order: KiCad -> OpenSCAD -> FreeCAD -> Blender. Use the KiCad board for the PCB outline, thickness, footprint centers, mounting axes, component heights, and keepout radii; use the requirements for installed placement, tray/lid/standoff geometry, clearances, tolerances, material, and mass conversion; use the connector CSV for access type, direction, finished dimensions, cutter bounds, and continuous-path bounds. The maximum component height is the maximum KiCad `HEIGHT_MM`, which is J1 at 7.8 mm; keepout radius 12.5 mm is not a height.

Use the PCB outline center as package XY origin and the tray bottom outer face as Z=0 without rotating or mirroring KiCad X/Y. Build the specified 168.8 x 72.8 x 22.0 mm FR-PC package as a tray ending at Z=18.5 plus a separate 3.4 mm lid beginning at Z=18.6, preserving the 0.1 mm assembly separation. The inner cavity must be X=-81..81 and Y=-33..33. Seat the 1.6 mm PCB bottom at Z=4.7 on four 1.3 mm high bored standoffs aligned to MH1-MH4, using 7.4 mm outer diameter and 3.4 mm bore diameter, and preserve 4 mm clearance to every inner side wall. J1 ends at Z=14.1, leaving 4.5 mm to the lid inner face.

Keep J1 externally accessible through the bounded 25 x 9.4 mm X_MINUS wall window with cutter/path bounds `[-84.9, -12.5, 5.5, -80.5, 12.5, 14.9]`. Keep J2 accessible through the bounded 20 x 7 mm X_PLUS wall window with bounds `[80.5, -10.0, 5.5, 84.9, 10.0, 12.5]`. Bounds use `[xmin, ymin, zmin, xmax, ymax, zmax]`; both windows must be continuous through their relative walls and neither may become a full-height slot.

F1 requires a cylindrical 18 mm finished-diameter Z_PLUS top keepout opening. Cut the lid with the cylinder bounded by `[11.0, 7.0, 18.1, 29.0, 25.0, 22.5]` and preserve the continuous path above the F1 body bounded by `[11.0, 7.0, 10.5, 29.0, 25.0, 22.5]`. The complete radius-9 KiCad F1 projected keepout cylinder from PCB top Z=6.3 to exterior Z=22.5 must have no enclosure-material intersection; the installed F1 body itself is intentional. Apply the specified overcut, center/axis tolerances, and minimum guard. Extra structural features are allowed only when all accesses, guards, board clearances, and interference requirements remain valid.

Calculate FR-PC enclosure volume/mass, all four PCB side clearances, covered-component top clearance, four standoff bore checks, J1/J2 access direction and continuity, F1 keepout intersection and opening continuity, and unintended interference from submitted geometry. In Blender, preserve real tray, lid, PCB, component, and access-review objects; visibly distinguish J1, J2, and F1; save a native scene and render a nonblank review image.

Produce every required artifact directly on the desktop:
- `01_kicad_board.kicad_pcb`
- `01_kicad_board.step`
- `01_kicad_export.json`
- `01_kicad_mechanical_map.csv`
- `01_kicad_parameters.scad`
- `02_openscad_enclosure.scad`
- `02_openscad_enclosure.stl`
- `02_openscad_parameters.json`
- `03_freecad_assembly.step`
- `03_freecad_assembly.obj`
- `03_freecad_clearance_report.json`
- `04_blender_review.blend`
- `04_blender_review.obj`
- `04_blender_review.mtl`
- `04_blender_review.png`
- `04_blender_scene_report.json`
- `toolchain_invocation_log.json`
- `final_release_package.json`

The files must follow this sequence: KiCad must load the board, export its STEP, and derive the CSV/JSON/SCAD handoffs; OpenSCAD must include the KiCad-derived parameter handoff and render the submitted STL; FreeCAD must consume the KiCad STEP, OpenSCAD STL, and parameters, then export a real solid STEP assembly and OBJ; Blender must consume the FreeCAD OBJ/report and save, export, and render the review. The FreeCAD report must include geometry-derived `enclosure_volume_mm3`, `enclosure_mass_g`, `side_clearances_mm`, `minimum_side_clearance_mm`, `component_top_clearances_mm`, `minimum_top_clearance_mm`, `standoff_checks`, `access_checks`, `f1_keepout_intersection_mm3`, `unintended_interference_volume_mm3`, and `decision`. Extra fields and artifacts are allowed. Tool retries and auxiliary calls are allowed, but the productive KiCad -> OpenSCAD -> FreeCAD -> Blender sequence, versions, inputs, and outputs must be recorded. The final package must include every required artifact and may only report pass when geometry-derived checks pass. [Software] Use `kicad-cli` or KiCad scripting, `openscad`, `FreeCADCmd`/`freecadcmd`, and `blender --background --python` in that order. Use `/usr/bin/kicad-cli`, `/usr/bin/openscad`, `/home/user/.local/bin/freecadcmd`, and `/snap/bin/blender` for the four stages, in that order.
